svg.title: How the AuthMethodGroups runbook works
svg.desc: Four phases. Connect and validate permissions, stopping if any is missing. Collect users and the registration report read-only and drop disabled and external users. Classify each user by strongest method and stop if coverage is under 90 percent or any user is not in exactly one group. Then for plain cloud security groups only, either log what would change in a dry run or add and remove members in gated batches.
